artifacts.description_tr: Gümüş kupalar ve bronz atlet figürü içeren kupa koleksiyonu. Okulun zengin atletik geleneğini gösteren vitrin düzenlemesi.
artifacts.description_en: Trophy collection with cups and athlete figurine, showcasing the school's rich athletic tradition.
artifacts.description_el: Συλλογή κυπέλλων με αγάλματα αθλητών, που αναδεικνύει την αθλητική παράδοση του σχολείου.

artifacts.description_tr: "SINIF III" yazan eski ahşap kapı tabelası. Altın yaldızlı harfler, çatlaklar ve yıpranmışlık izleri okulun derin tarihini yansıtır.
artifacts.description_en: Antique wooden classroom door sign reading "SINIF III" (Class III), with gold-leaf lettering showing century-old patina.
artifacts.description_el: Αρχαία ξύλινη πινακίδα πόρτας τάξης "SINIF III" με χρυσά γράμματα.

artifacts.description_tr: "ÖĞRETMENLER" yazılı metal oda tabelası. Altın harflerle siyah zemin üzerine yazılmış, tarihi levha.
artifacts.description_en: Historic metal room sign reading "ÖĞRETMENLER" (Teachers) with gold letters on black background.
artifacts.description_el: Μεταλλική πινακίδα δωματίου "ÖĞRETMENLER" (Καθηγητές) με χρυσά γράμματα.

artifacts.description_tr: "MÜDÜR YARDIMCISI" yazılı emaye kapı tabelası. Okul idaresinin tarihi işareti.
artifacts.description_en: Enamel door sign reading "MÜDÜR YARDIMCISI" (Vice Principal) — a historical marker of school administration.
artifacts.description_el: Πινακίδα σμάλτου "MÜDÜR YARDIMCISI" (Υποδιευθυντής).

artifacts.description_tr: Okul binasının renkli cephe çizimi. Defne çelenkli giriş, panjurlu pencereler ve kapı detaylarıyla mimari eskiz.
artifacts.description_en: Colored architectural sketch of the school façade with wreath-adorned entrance and shuttered windows.
artifacts.description_el: Χρωματιστό αρχιτεκτονικό σκίτσο της πρόσοψης του σχολείου.

artifacts.description_tr: Bir öğrencinin çizdiği okul binası cephe çizimi. Simetrik pencereler ve defne çelengi detayları.
artifacts.description_en: Student drawing of the school building façade with symmetric windows and laurel wreath detail.
artifacts.description_el: Μαθητικό σχέδιο της πρόσοψης του σχολείου.

artifacts.description_tr: "Öğrenci Durumu" başlıklı çerçeveli kara tahta. Sınıf I–VI arası kayıtlı ve gelmeyen öğrenci sayılarını gösteren tablo.
artifacts.description_en: Framed blackboard titled "Student Status" tracking enrollment and absenteeism by class (I–VI) and gender.
artifacts.description_el: Πίνακας "Κατάσταση Μαθητών" για την καταγραφή φοίτησης ανά τάξη.

artifacts.description_tr: Mustafa Güneri tarafından hazırlanmış Bitişik-Dik Yazı öğretim tablosu. Aksaray-İstanbul basımı.
artifacts.description_en: Cursive handwriting instruction chart by Mustafa Güneri (Aksaray, Istanbul), teaching the Turkish alphabet.
artifacts.description_el: Πίνακας εκμάθησης τουρκικής πλάγιας γραφής από τον Mustafa Güneri.

artifacts.description_tr: "Η ΚΡΙΣΙΣ ΤΟΥ ΣΟΛΟΜΩΝΤΟΣ" başlıklı Yunanca eğitim tablosu. Selanik, P. Zaharopoulos basımı.

artifacts.description_en: Row of three vintage wooden school desks with chestnut-brown paint, worn by decades of daily use.
artifacts.description_el: Σειρά τριών παλιών ξύλινων σχολικών θρανίων.

artifacts.description_tr: Öğretmenlere mahsus cep not defterleri. Pembe ve mavi kapaklı iki adet not defteri.
artifacts.description_en: Teacher's pocket grade books — two notebooks (pink and blue covers) labeled for the school year.
artifacts.description_el: Βαθμολόγια τσέπης καθηγητών — δύο τετράδια.

artifacts.description_tr: Coğrafya derslerinde dünyayı keşfetmek için kullanılan antika yerküre (υδρόγειος).
artifacts.description_en: Antique school globe (υδρόγειος) used in geography classes for exploring the world.
artifacts.description_el: Αρχαία σχολική υδρόγειος σφαίρα για τα μαθήματα γεωγραφίας.

artifacts.description_tr: Ahşap kutu içinde pirinç pusula, teleskop ve büyüteç seti. Coğrafya eğitimi için kullanılan zarif bir keşif aracı.
artifacts.description_en: Brass compass, telescope and magnifying glass set in a walnut wood box — an elegant exploration tool for geography education.
artifacts.description_el: Σετ πυξίδας, τηλεσκοπίου και μεγεθυντικού φακού σε ξύλινη θήκη.

artifacts.description_tr: Bakır sefer tası. Ahşap sapı ve iç içe geçen üç bölmesiyle, öğrencilerin yemeklerini okula taşıdığı geleneksel yemek kabı.
artifacts.description_en: Copper tiffin carrier (sefer tası) with wooden handle and three stacking compartments, used by students to carry lunch.
artifacts.description_el: Χάλκινο σκεύος μεταφοράς φαγητού (sefer tası) με ξύλινη λαβή.

artifacts.description_tr: Eski deri okul çantası. El dikişli, yıpranmış kahverengi deri, dönemin öğrencilerinin kitap ve defterlerini taşıdığı evrak çantası.
artifacts.description_en: Vintage hand-stitched leather school briefcase in worn brown leather — the classic way students carried books.
artifacts.description_el: Δερμάτινη σχολική τσάντα ραμμένη στο χέρι.

artifacts.description_tr: "ANNE" başlıklı el yazısı şiir. Sınıf IV öğrencisi Vasiliki Kunadi tarafından yazılmış, çiçek bordürüyle süslenmiş.
artifacts.description_en: Handwritten poem titled "ANNE" (Mother) by Class IV student Vasiliki Kunadi, decorated with floral border.
artifacts.description_el: Χειρόγραφο ποίημα "ANNE" (Μητέρα) της μαθήτριας Βασιλική Κουνάδη, Τάξη IV.

artifacts.description_tr: Sınıf IV öğrencisi Malamo Bocos tarafından çizilmiş Karagöz-Hacivat çizimi. Geleneksel Türk gölge oyunu karakteri.
artifacts.description_en: Crayon drawing of Karagöz (shadow puppet character) by Malamo Bocos, Class IV — traditional Turkish shadow play.
artifacts.description_el: Σχέδιο Karagöz από τη Μαλάμω Μπόκος, Τάξη IV.

artifacts.title_en: Solon Bust Drawing — "Founder of Athenian Democracy"
artifacts.description_tr: A. İoannidu tarafından çizilmiş Solon büstü. "Atinada Demokrasi idaresini kuranlardan Solon" yazısıyla.
artifacts.description_en: Drawing of Solon's bust by A. Ioannidu, Class II — "Solon, one of the founders of Athenian democracy."
artifacts.description_el: Σχέδιο προτομής Σόλωνα από τον/τη Α. Ιωαννίδου, Τάξη II.

artifacts.description_tr: Karlı gökyüzünde hediyeleriyle gelen Noel Baba'nın renkli kalem çizimi. "1 Ocak 1966" tarihli.
artifacts.description_en: Student drawing of Santa Claus in the snow, dated "January 1, 1966" — a holiday crayon illustration.
artifacts.description_el: Μαθητικό σχέδιο Αγίου Βασιλείου στο χιόνι, 1 Ιανουαρίου 1966.

artifacts.description_tr: "GÜNAYDIN" başlıklı şiir ve çizim. Maria Hirpaki tarafından yazılmış, okul zili ve sepet çizimleriyle süslenmiş.
artifacts.description_en: Illustrated poem "GÜNAYDIN" (Good Morning) by Maria Hirpaki with drawings of school bell and basket.
artifacts.description_el: Εικονογραφημένο ποίημα "GÜNAYDIN" (Καλημέρα) από τη Μαρία Χειρπάκη.

artifacts.description_tr: Sınıf V öğrencisi Niko Mavridis tarafından çizilmiş kalem portre. IDPAI-A10-58 katalog numaralı.
artifacts.description_en: Pencil portrait of Sultan Murad III by Niko Mavridis, Class V — cataloged as IDPAI-A10-58.
artifacts.description_el: Πορτρέτο Σουλτάνου Μουράτ Γ΄ από τον Νίκο Μαυρίδη, Τάξη V.

artifacts.description_tr: İtfaiye, polis ve diğer acil durum numaralarını listeleyen çerçeveli acil telefon numaraları levhası. Okulun koridorlarından kalma tarihi güvenlik tabelası.

artifacts.description_el: Πίνακας τηλεφώνων έκτακτης ανάγκης — ένα ιστορικό ενημερωτικό πλαίσιο.

artifacts.description_tr: Sıra, kara tahta ve kırsal sahneleri tasvir eden duvar resimleriyle sınıf iç görünümü. Okulun günlük yaşamından bir kesit.
artifacts.description_en: Interior view of a classroom with student desks, blackboard, and wall murals depicting rural scenes — a glimpse into the school's daily life.
artifacts.description_el: Εσωτερικό αίθουσας με θρανία, πίνακα και τοιχογραφίες — στιγμιότυπο σχολικής ζωής.

artifacts.title_en: "A School Closes a Thousand Prisons" Quote Plaque
artifacts.title_el: Πλακέτα Αποφθέγματος "Ένα Σχολείο Κλείνει Χίλιες Φυλακές"

artifacts.description_el: Κορνιζαρισμένο γνωμικό: "Ένα σχολείο κλείνει χίλιες φυλακές" — σοφία του Βίκτωρ Ουγκό.

artifacts.description_el: Χάλκινη πλάκα "ΙΔΡΥΘΕΝ ΤΩ 1954 ΔΑΠΑΝΑΙΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΟΥ ΗΛΙΑΔΟΥ ΕΙΣ ΜΝΗΜΗΝ ΑΘΗΝΑΣ ΗΛΙΑΔΟΥ".

artifacts.description_en: Official school sign under T.C. Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı: "İstanbul - Beyoğlu ÖZEL KARAKÖY RUM ANA ve İLKÖĞRETİM OKULU".
artifacts.description_el: Επίσημη πινακίδα σχολείου: "Ιδιωτικό Ρωμαίικο Δημοτικό Σχολείο Καρακιόι".

artifacts.description_tr: Kurutulmuş çiçek düzenlemesiyle süslenmiş dökme demir eski soba. Bir zamanlar sınıfı ısıtan soba, artık dekoratif bir kalıntı.
artifacts.description_en: Cast-iron vintage stove adorned with dried flower arrangement — once a classroom heater, now a decorative relic.
artifacts.description_el: Παλιά σόμπα από χυτοσίδηρο διακοσμημένη με αποξηραμένα λουλούδια.

artifacts.description_tr: Kırmızı ve beyaz geometrik yıldız desenli orijinal zemin karosu. Okulun Osmanlı dönemi iç mekanının karakteristik öğesi.
artifacts.description_en: Original decorative floor tile with geometric star pattern in red and white — characteristic of the school's Ottoman-era interior.
artifacts.description_el: Γεωμετρικό πλακάκι δαπέδου με αστερόσχημο μοτίβο — χαρακτηριστικό οθωμανικής εποχής.

artifacts.description_tr: Yuvarlak kırmızı elektrikli soba. Kauçuk ayakları ve metal kilidiyle 20. yüzyıl ortası sınıf ısıtma cihazı.
artifacts.description_en: Round red electric heater with rubber feet and metal clasp — a mid-century classroom heating appliance.
artifacts.description_el: Στρογγυλή κόκκινη ηλεκτρική θερμάστρα — συσκευή θέρμανσης αίθουσας.

artifacts.description_tr: 1950 etiketli ahşap kasalı "Pilot Radio" kısa dalga/orta dalga radyo. Dünya radyo istasyonlarını okula taşıyan tarihi cihaz.
artifacts.description_en: Vintage "Pilot Radio" shortwave/medium wave radio in wooden cabinet, labeled "(2) 1950" — once broadcasting world stations to the school.
artifacts.description_el: Παλιό ραδιόφωνο "Pilot Radio" βραχέων/μεσαίων κυμάτων σε ξύλινο κέλυφος, 1950.

artifacts.description_tr: Çift zilli elektrikli okul zili sistemi. Nesiller boyu ders saatlerini belirleyen tanıdık ses.
artifacts.description_en: Double-bell electric school bell system with metal housing — the familiar sound that marked class periods for generations.
artifacts.description_el: Ηλεκτρικό σχολικό κουδούνι διπλού καμπάνα — ο γνωστός ήχος των μαθημάτων.

artifacts.description_tr: TN markalı büyük endüstriyel duvar saati. Siyah metal çerçeve ve beyaz kadranıyla okul koridorunda zamanı gösteren saat.
artifacts.description_en: Large TN-brand industrial wall clock with black metal frame and white face — once keeping school time in the hallway.
artifacts.description_el: Μεγάλο βιομηχανικό ρολόι τοίχου μάρκας TN — κρατούσε τη σχολική ώρα.

artifacts.description_tr: Yeşil patinalı ağır bronz okul çanı. Derslerin başlangıç ve bitişini duyurmak için elle çalınan tarihi çan.
artifacts.description_en: Heavy bronze school bell with verdigris patina and forged handle — hand-rung to announce the start and end of classes.
artifacts.description_el: Βαριά χάλκινη σχολική καμπάνα με πατίνα — χτυπούσε για αρχή και τέλος μαθημάτων.

artifacts.description_tr: Fransız ODO markalı Art Deco sarkaçlı duvar saati. Ceviz ahşap kasada, müdür odasında bulunan zarif saat.
artifacts.description_en: French ODO brand Art Deco pendulum wall clock in walnut case — an elegant timepiece from the school's principal office.
artifacts.description_el: Γαλλικό ρολόι τοίχου ODO Art Deco με εκκρεμές σε κάσα καρυδιάς.

artifacts.description_tr: 1982-83 öğretim yılı ders programı. Yunanca/Türkçe, matematik, müzik ve beden eğitimi derslerini gösteren el yazısı çizelge.
artifacts.description_en: Handwritten class schedule for the 1982-83 academic year, showing daily periods for language (Yunanca/Turkce), math, music, and physical education.
artifacts.description_el: Χειρόγραφο πρόγραμμα μαθημάτων 1982-83: Ελληνικά/Τουρκικά, μαθηματικά, μουσική, γυμναστική.

artifacts.description_tr: Mavi-yeşil Melitta mekanik çark hesap makinesi. Okul idaresi ve muhasebesinde kullanılan hassas hesaplama cihazı.
artifacts.description_en: Blue-green Melitta mechanical pinwheel calculator — a precision computing device used for school administration and accounting.
artifacts.description_el: Μηχανική αριθμομηχανή Melitta — συσκευή υπολογισμών σχολικής διοίκησης.

artifacts.description_tr: Okul koridorunda yer alan uzun ahşap vestiyer bankı. Dökme demir askıları ve açık raflı oturma alanıyla öğrencilerin paltolarını astığı mekan.
artifacts.description_en: Long wooden coat rack with bench and cast-iron hooks along the school hallway — where students hung their coats before class.
artifacts.description_el: Μακρύ ξύλινο παγκάκι με κρεμάστρες στο σχολικό διάδρομο.
